business_problem: Building that product required infrastructure that would never go down. Early on, WeSpeak ran on a virtual private server that could fail without warning, taking the entire platform offline. For a hotel waiting on a guest's booking decision, every minute the platform was down was a direct revenue loss. WeSpeak needed infrastructure that matched the stakes of the business it was serving.
solution_summary: Moving to Google Cloud solved the infrastructure problem. eliminated the fixed server entirely, deploying serverless containers that scale automatically to handle guest inquiries across WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok. To power these omnichannel conversations, WeSpeak leverages Gemini Pro and Gemini Flash using Gemini platform and Google AI Studio. WeSpeak ran more than a thousand automated tests on every model considered, measuring hallucination rates across real hotel scenarios. Gemini platform routes each conversation to the right model: Gemini Pro for the most complex hotels and Gemini Flash for the majority of properties where speed is the priority. Google AI Studio runs in the background as a fallback, ensuring that if Gemini platform ever has an issue, the guest still receives a response built with the same Gemini models.
